policies.rationale: Legacy authentication protocols (IMAP, POP3, SMTP AUTH, older Office clients) do not support modern authentication and cannot enforce MFA. They are the most common vector for password-spray attacks.
policies.rolloutNote: Start in report-only mode for 7 days. Review sign-in logs filtered by 'Client App = Legacy Authentication Clients' before enforcing.

policies.rationale: Privileged accounts are the highest-value target. A compromised Global Admin account without MFA is a full tenant takeover.
policies.rolloutNote: No staged rollout needed for admin accounts - enable directly, but ensure break-glass accounts are excluded and tested first.

policies.displayName: CA003 - Require MFA for All Users
policies.rationale: Microsoft reports MFA blocks over 99.9% of account compromise attacks. This is the single highest-impact security control available.
policies.rolloutNote: Pair with the MFA Rollout Kit template for a phased 3-week communication plan. Do not enable before users have registered authentication methods.
